QuestInfo.name: Spy Training 1
QuestInfo.0: Since you're going to infiltrate Kerning City, you need some spy training. Talk to Ryden about what you should do.
QuestInfo.1:
Ryden says you'll have to undergo all sorts of different types of training from now on. Your first mission? Locate the #rbox that's shaped slightly differently#k from the other boxes and destroy it.

0.0: For a special mission like yours, you'll need special training. Just remember: all wounds heal, and pain doesn't last. Ready to begin?

yes.0: First, you must hone your skills of observation. Within #bPractice Place 1#k, you'll find several boxes. One of them is #rslightly different from the rest#k. Destroy that box.

no.0: If you want to be a spy, you'll have to go through the training...

1.0: A cinch, wasn't it? One of my favorite tests. Next, I hope you're quick on your feet...

mob.0: Do you need an eye exam perhaps? If so, you may not be suitable for this job. Head to #bPractice Place 1#k, and destroy the box that's #rslightly different from the rest#k.
